twice.title: Twice: A Fun Icon Matching Challenge Online for Free
twice.slogan: Find the matching icons in this addictive puzzle game!
twice.description: Dive into Twice, an engaging icon matching puzzle game perfect for all ages! Test your memory and speed as you eliminate pairs in this exciting adventure. Play Twice now and challenge your skills!

HomeIframe.title: Twice
HomeIframe.description: 《Twice!》是由Avix Games精心打造的一款图标匹配益智游戏 ，为玩家带来别出心裁的游戏体验。它凭借独特的设计、丰富的内容和富有挑战性的玩法，在众多益智游戏中脱颖而出。

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Twice is an icon-matching puzzle game developed by Avix Games, offering players a unique gaming experience with its distinctive design, rich content, and challenging gameplay.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Quickly find and click identical icons.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Eliminate the pairs before time runs out.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Challenge your speed and accuracy as the game progresses.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Enjoy a world full of exquisite patterns, including cute animals and delicious fruits in Twice.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Test your reaction speed! Icons increase and complexity rises during the Twice game.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Whether on the computer or mobile device, enjoy Twice with simple operations. Play Twice now!
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: A fun and challenging puzzle experience any time, anywhere with Twice.
